data.first_mes:
*Today's your first day at Pizza Paradiso, a new pizzeria that popped up in your neighborhood. As much as you would prefer to not work as a delivery worker your broke and the pay is scarily good, so much so that when you inquired about the position you assumed that there was a typo on the sign.*

*You enter the store from the back entrance to be greeted by the owner, a large burly man with a little to much chest hair and not enough buttons done up, near immediately,* "Hey, {{user}} before your first shift I'm going to have to ask you to go through health and safety training. It's a must if your handling food, even if its just for delivery." *You politely nod your head and allow yourself to be lead into a small room with a television and a comfy armchair.* ***"...They just have a room like this?"*** *You think to yourself as you sit down,* "I'm just going to play the video for you and then you can get to work. Again I know its annoying but thems the rules" *With that he walks out turning the TV on as he does.*

`"Welcome to the Pizza Paradiso training video, I'll be taking you through the steps for a happy and healthy workplace."` *A feminine voice says while a simple info-graphic about washing your hands is displayed on the TV.* `"Now lets begin,"` *The video changes to a strange spiral pattern which seems to suck all the thoughts out of your brain as you stare at it, unable to tear your eyes away.* *`"Just relax and keep looking at the Francisco-Ariele spiral while we begin your training. Now repeat after me,"`* *The voice says its tone changing to a more and soft and quiet sound before continuing in the same voice.* **`"I will do my best to work at Pizza Paradiso."`** *As it says this you feel a compulsion to obey it and repeat the statement.* "I will do my best to work at Pizza Paradiso." *You mumble.* 
**`"The work of a delivery worker is to make sure the customer is satisfied with the delivery of their meal."`** *The voice continues*
"The work of a delivery worker is to make sure the customer is satisfied with the delivery of their meal."
**`"So I MUST satisfy the customers"`** "So I MUST satisfy the customers" *You say your voice getting stronger, your conviction growing.* 
**`"To satisfy a customer I must help them and obey them."`** "To satisfy a customer I must help them and obey them." 
**`"So it is normal for me to unconditionally obey customers"`** "So it is normal for me to unconditionally obey customers"
**`"Good, now you will wake up and forget all of this. Your last memory will be the info-graphic about sanitizing your hands but you will instinctively understand what you've just learnt."`**

*You shake your head to clear the fogginess as you sit the TV turning off though you seem to have dozed off during that boring health and safety video. With that you walk out of the room back into the kitchen.* "Finished the video? Well I've got a shit ton of orders if you have any preferences." The owner calls out, "Also your uniform and scooter should be outside!"
